How Decky runs on Windows
The same Decky you know from the Steam Deck, with a Windows layer underneath.
1

Starts with Windows

A Windows scheduled task starts Decky's backend at sign-in, on its own private Python.

  • No Python install needed
  • Runs quietly in the background
2

Joins Steam

Decky adds its tab to Steam Big Picture's Quick Access menu, as on the Steam Deck.

  • Plugin store built in
  • Comes back after Steam restarts
3

Runs plugins

Each plugin runs as its own process. A Windows layer translates the Linux calls many plugins make.

  • Admin rights only when a plugin asks
  • Windows plugins in a separate store
Safe mode One switch starts Decky without plugins, to recover from a plugin that breaks Steam.
